evidence_boundary: Tarragon essential oil stimulus tested explicitly for familiarity and label consistency. The groups differed in sensory panel experience. No symptom intervention.
Reported odor activity values describe tarragon leaf aroma chemistry and are not patient threshold improvements.
Tarragon included in exact tested odor-memory pairs, with results pooled across odors and no ingredient-specific contrast. Separate from the 2011 lesion experiment.
The hippocampal and prefrontal lesion study reuses the tarragon stimuli and reports pooled results across distinct perturbation groups.
